item.title: MetaMask Launches AI Wallet for Autonomous Crypto Trading
item.summary: MetaMask has unveiled Agent Wallet, a self-custodial cryptocurrency wallet designed to enable artificial intelligence agents to conduct autonomous on-chain trading without relying on third-party control. The launch represents a significant expansion of AI-driven functionality within decentralized finance (DeFi), allowing users to automate digital asset trading while retaining custody of their funds.
